full_name: Maria Tatar | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 Humanities Marion Cabot Putnam Fellow Harvard University
bio: Maria Tatar is the John L. Loeb Professor of Germanic Languages and Literatures at Harvard University, where she teaches courses on German cultural studies, folklore, and children’s literature.
